content: --- id doc-readme title README route /docs/readme icon material-symbols-light info-outline order 4 category Docs --- Nexus-UX Signal-Driven Universal Reactivity. High-Fidelity Tailwind JIT. Omni-State DOM-as-State Framework. Nexus-UX is a reactive framework designed for developers who demand absolute performance granular control and a zero-build experience. It collapses the traditional frontend stack by treating the DOM as a queryable reactive state graph while achieving 100 functional parity with Tailwind v4 . --- The Five Pillars 1. Omni-State DOM-as-State We assert that the DOM _is_ the primary state graph. No phantom Virtual DOM. No reconciliation tax. The HTML attributes are the declaration source while the binary signal heap is the runtime truth. 2. Native JIT Engine Tailwind v4 Nexus-UX achieves 1 1 bit-for-bit parity with the official Tailwind v4 CDN. It compiles utility classes into a high-performance Unified Adopted StyleSheets Registry in real-time. 3. Zero-DOM Pollution Using CSSStyleSheet.replaceSync Nexus-UX eliminates all legacy and tag pollution. Styles automatically penetrate Shadow DOM boundaries without duplicative parsing. 4. ZCZS Zero-Copy Zero-Serialization A value-pooling reactive core designed for 120fps animations. Data flows from kernel to DOM via binary signal heaps bypassing JSON serialization. 5. title: Modifiers
content: Modifiers Labs Category 15 Event Modifiers Event Modifiers Filters Pipeline event modifiers that attach directly to event directives e.g. data-on-click_outside or input_debounce.250 to intercept throttle filter and coordinate interactions. _debounce Timing Delays execution until specified milliseconds have elapsed since the last invocation. Open Lab rarr _delay Timing Delays handler execution by a fixed millisecond timeout before firing. Open Lab rarr _document Target Attaches event listener to document root rather than the local HTMLElement. Open Lab rarr _drag Pointer Injects delta movement coordinates drag.dx drag.dy into pointer handlers. Open Lab rarr _hold Gesture Fires only when user presses and holds the pointer for the specified millisecond duration. Open Lab rarr _keys Keyboard Filters keyboard events by key code or combination enter escape space ctrl shift . Open Lab rarr _morph Morph Morphs return string from evaluation directly into the element using morphDOM diffing. Open Lab rarr _once Lifecycle Executes event listener exactly once automatically unbinding itself afterwards. Open Lab rarr _outside Outside Fires handler only when pointer click or tap occurs outside the element boundary bounds. Open Lab rarr _prevent Default Invokes event.preventDefault to halt native browser default submission and navigation. Open Lab rarr _self Target Executes handler only if event.target is the element itself ignoring child bubbled events. Open Lab rarr _stop Propagation Calls
